gloss: to cut, to mow, to harvest

definitions.explanation: To cut crops or grass from a field.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}の{髪|かみ}を{短|みじか}く{刈|か}った。
examples.english: I cut my son's hair short.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{農家|のうか}は{稲|いね}を{刈|か}る。
examples.english: When autumn comes, farmers harvest rice.

notes:
{刈|か}る is a godan verb meaning to cut short (hair, grass) or to harvest (crops). It implies cutting at the base or close to the surface.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜を{刈|か}る

SENSE 1 - TO CUT (hair/grass):
- {髪|かみ}を{刈|か}る: to cut hair (short/buzz cut)
- {芝|しば}/{芝生|しばふ}を{刈|か}る: to mow the lawn
- {草|くさ}を{刈|か}る: to cut grass

SENSE 2 - TO HARVEST:
- {稲|いね}を{刈|か}る: to harvest rice
- {麦|むぎ}を{刈|か}る: to harvest wheat

HOMOPHONES (different kanji):
- {刈|か}る: to cut, mow, harvest
- {借|か}りる: to borrow (ichidan verb)
- {狩|か}る: to hunt
- {駆|か}る: to drive, impel

RELATED:
- {刈|か}り{込|こ}む: to trim, prune
- {刈|か}り{取|と}る: to mow, reap
